questions.question: Which of the following factors is most likely to stimulate ventilation after strenuous exercise?

options.text: Collateral impulses from higher than brain centres

questions.explanation:
The stimulus to ventilation after strenuous exercise is increased mean arterial H+.

The respiratory rate after exercise does not reach a basal level until the O2 debt is repaid. The
stimulus for ventilation is increased mean arterial H+ due to an increase in blood lactic acid
levels. Most of the lactic acid is converted to glycogen and some amount is converted to CO2 and
H20.
